report_sentences: Reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch showed no detectable effect.
I varied mass, radius, shape, air density, temperature, reflectance, stripes, hardness and batch.

- **Null effects:** In the 0.3 kg sphere series, temperature (−20 vs 80 °C), reflectance (0 vs 1), stripes (0 vs 10), hardness (1 vs 10) and batch (1 vs 50) all give flight times within about 0.02 s and impact speeds within about 0.1–0.2 m/s of the baseline.
Reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch appear irrelevant.
